description_en: Modifies an internal network access policy for the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号下内网访问策略
name: UpdatePrivateAccessPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the internal network access policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): Lists internal network access policies.
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Creates an internal network access policy
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
[ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
[CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.example: 这是一条内网访问策略
parameters.help_en: The description of the internal network access policy. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The action of the internal network access policy. Valid values:
Block: Blocks.
Allow: Allows
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
Block：阻断。
Allow：允许
parameters.name: policy_action

parameters.help_en:
The application type of the internal network access policy. Valid values:
Application: Application.
Tag: Tag
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
Application：应用。
Tag：标签
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the applications for the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 internal network access application IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。一条策略最多支持100个内网访问应用ID
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the tags for internal network access. A single policy supports up to 100 internal network access tag IDs
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。一条策略最多支持100个内网访问标签ID
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en:
The user group type of the internal network access policy. Valid values:
Normal: Regular user group.
Custom: Custom user group
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
Normal：普通用户组。
Custom：自定义用户组
parameters.name: user_group_mode

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the user groups for the internal network access policy. This parameter is required when the user group type is Normal. This parameter is mutually exclusive with the custom user group collection. A single policy supports up to 10,000 user groups, and you can modify up to 2,000 user group IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的用户组ID集合，当用户组类型为Normal时，必填。和自定义用户组集合互斥。单个策略的用户组最大支持10000个，单次修改的用户组ID数量最多2000个
parameters.name: user_group_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the identity source for the custom user group. This parameter is required when the custom user group type is department
fields.help_zh: 自定义用户组的身份源ID。当自定义用户组类型为department时，必填
fields.name: idp_id

fields.help_en:
The relation of the custom user group. Valid values:
Equal: Equal to.
Unequal: Not equal to
fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组的关系。取值：
Equal：等于。
Unequal：不等于
fields.name: relation

fields.help_en:
The type of the custom user group. Valid values:
username: Username.
department: Department.
email: Email address.
telephone: Mobile phone number
fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组的类型。取值：
username：用户名。
department：部门。
email：邮箱。
telephone：手机
fields.name: user_group_type

fields.help_en:
The value of the custom user group attribute.
If the user group type is username, this parameter specifies the username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at signs (@), and spaces.
If the user group type is department, this parameter specifies the department. Example: OU=Department1,OU=SASE DingTalk.
If the user group type is email, this parameter specifies the email address. Example: username@example.com.
If the user group type is telephone, this parameter specifies the mobile phone number. Example: 13900001234
fields.help_zh:
自定义用户组属性的值。
当用户组类型为username时，表示用户名的值。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格。
当用户组类型为department时，表示部门的值。如：OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉。
当用户组类型为email时，表示邮箱的值。如：username@example.com。
当用户组类型为telephone时，表示手机的值。如：13900001234
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The custom user groups for the internal network access policy. This parameter is required when the user group type is Custom. This parameter is mutually exclusive with the user group ID collection. You can configure up to 10 custom user groups in total
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略的自定义用户组集合，当用户组类型为Custom时，必填。和用户组ID集合互斥。自定义用户组总数最多10个
parameters.name: custom_user_attributes

parameters.help_en:
The status of the internal network access policy. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The policy priority of the internal network access policy. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1 to 1000. The maximum value is the total number of internal network access policies minus one
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1~1000，最大值为内网访问策略总数减一
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The modification type of the internal network access policy. Valid values:
Cover (default): Uses the values of the ApplicationIds, UserGroupIds, and CustomUserAttributes parameters to overwrite the original application ID collection, user group ID collection, and custom user group collection.
Append: Adds the values specified in the ApplicationIds, UserGroupIds, and CustomUserAttributes parameters to the original application ID collection, user group ID collection, and custom user group collection
parameters.help_zh:
内网访问策略的修改类型。取值：
Cover（默认）：使用ApplicationIds、UserGroupIds、CustomUserAttributes参数的值覆盖原应用ID集合、用户组ID集合、自定义用户组集合。
Append：在原应用ID集合、用户组ID集合、自定义用户组集合中分别增加ApplicationIds、UserGroupIds、CustomUserAttributes参数中输入的值
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security baseline policy
parameters.help_zh: 安全基线策略的ID
parameters.name: device_attribute_id

parameters.help_en:
The action to take when the security baseline is not met. Valid values:
Block: Blocks.
Observe: Observes
parameters.help_zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：

Block：拦截。
Observe：观察
parameters.name: device_attribute_action

parameters.help_en: The ID of the trigger template
parameters.help_zh: 触发模板ID
parameters.name: trigger_template_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the trusted software
parameters.help_zh: 可信软件ID
parameters.name: trusted_software_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the trusted process groups
parameters.help_zh: 可信进程组ID
parameters.name: trusted_process_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The status of the trusted process switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: trusted_process_status

parameters.help_en: The start time when the zero trust policy takes effect. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: valid_from

parameters.help_en: The end time when the zero trust policy takes effect. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳
parameters.name: valid_until

parameters.help_en:
The status of the effective period switch. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: valid_time_status

parameters.help_en: The Policy Name
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称
parameters.name: name
